svg.title: A fully labeled Normal orange-mass curve
svg.desc: The illustrative distribution has mean 100 grams and standard deviation 10 grams. Mass ticks from 70 through 130 grams align with z-scores from minus 3 through plus 3. The shaded upper tail begins at 120 grams, corresponding to z equals 2.
